data: Does the performance of the F1-Measure consistently increase as the number of hidden units increases?

Wait a moment, let me verify this carefully. Looking at the F1-Measure line, I can see that it starts at approximately 0.910 when the number of hidden units is 128. As the number of hidden units increases, the F1-Measure initially shows an upward trend, reaching its peak around 0.917 when the number of hidden units is 256. However, after this point, there is a slight decline in the F1-Measure value, which reaches approximately 0.910 when the number of hidden units is 384. Therefore, the performance of the F1-Measure does not consistently increase as the number of hidden units increases.
The answer is: No.
